verdict.rationale: Deepgram is an API-first product with documented public endpoints for pre-recorded transcription (POST /v1/listen), live streaming, and the voice-agent WebSocket, plus callbacks, short-lived JWT auth, and official SDKs in five languages. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at developers.deepgram.com/openapi.json and an agent-oriented llms.txt. Independent developers report building on the API (a NodeJS wrapper; a production stack where it 'works brilliantly').
